title: DataHause
description: The marketing website for DataHause, a data analytics and business intelligence consultancy. The site needed to convey technical credibility while remaining accessible to a non-technical audience. Clean typography, structured case-study sections, and clear calls-to-action guide visitors from awareness to contact.
highlights: Architected a component-driven layout system for rapid page assembly
Implemented structured data (JSON-LD) for improved search visibility
Built an animated stats section to highlight key business metrics
Ensured WCAG AA accessibility compliance across all interactive elements
